hero.titleAccent: that are traceable, explainable and accountable
hero.subtitle: AI Traceability brings together machine-learning prediction, SHAP explanations, multi-agent recommendations, sources and human validation in one complete, auditable file.
hero.previewAlt: Preview of the AI Traceability dashboard and decision monitoring

problem.title: Why trace AI-assisted decisions?
problem.subtitle: A prediction alone is not enough. To understand, control and audit a decision, you must keep the context, data, model, explanations, sources, AI recommendations and human intervention.

transparency.title: Lack of transparency
transparency.text: Users do not always know why a model proposes a given decision.

audit.title: Hard to audit
audit.text: Without history and integrity, reconstructing a decision file becomes difficult.

human.title: Human accountability
human.text: Artificial intelligence must assist the decision without replacing human control.

features.title: End-to-end traceability
features.subtitle: A platform for tracing, explaining and auditing decisions assisted by artificial intelligence.

ml.title: Machine Learning prediction
ml.text: Business data analysis while keeping the model, version and confidence score.

shap.title: SHAP explanation
shap.text: Identification of the factors that push the prediction up or down.

agents.title: Groq AI agents
agents.text: Consultation of several AI models to obtain complementary recommendations.

consensus.title: Multi-agent consensus
consensus.text: Agreement level between agents, without changing the ML prediction.

human.title: Human validation
human.text: Final decision taken by a validator from the complete file.

audit.title: Audit and integrity
audit.text: Event history, correlation ID, SHA-256 hashes and integrity chain.

how.title: From the business file to the final validation
how.subtitle: A clear path, from data capture to the human decision recorded in the auditable file.
how.note: Human validation covers the whole file, not each agent separately. AI agents provide complementary recommendations; the final decision remains human.

s1.title: File capture
s1.text: The credit officer captures the client file (application and financial data).

s2.title: ML and SHAP analysis
s2.text: The ML service generates a prediction and explains the associated factors.

s3.title: Multi-agent consultation
s3.text: Three Groq agents analyse the same file and propose their recommendations.

s4.title: Consensus and traceability
s4.text: The system computes the consensus, records sources and generates hashes.

s5.title: Human validation
s5.text: The validator reviews all information and takes the final decision.

tech.title: A modern, modular architecture
tech.subtitle: The stack actually used in the project, from the frontend to the ML service and AI agents.

security.title: Verifiable, auditable decisions
security.subtitle: Each file keeps the key events and integrity fingerprints so that changes can be detected and audits made easier. Designed to support transparency, audit and AI governance.
security.imageAlt: Illustration of the protection and integrity of decision files

jwt.title: JWT authentication
jwt.text: Protected access to the application and APIs.

roles.title: Role management
roles.text: Credit officer, validator, auditor and administrator.

history.title: Event history
history.text: Every step of the file is timestamped and searchable.

useCase.title: Main use case: credit application analysis
useCase.subtitle: The application analyses the financial information of a credit request, generates an ML prediction, explains SHAP factors, consults Groq agents, computes a consensus then sends the file to a human validator.
useCase.disclaimer: The system is a decision-support tool and does not replace the human decision.

risk.title: Risk analysis
risk.text: ML prediction on the application's financial data, with a confidence score and risk level.

explain.title: Prediction explainability
explain.text: SHAP factors to understand what drives the model to accept or reject.

audit.title: Validation and audit
audit.text: Multi-agent consensus, sources, history and recorded human decision.

human.title: A human remains accountable for the final decision
human.subtitle: The validator reviews the ML prediction, SHAP factors, agent answers, consensus, sources and file integrity before recording a final decision.
human.note: Groq and the ML model assist the analysis; they never take the final decision.

approve.title: Approve
approve.text: Confirm the proposed decision after reviewing the file.

reject.title: Reject
reject.text: Refuse the request and record the human decision.

modify.title: Modify
modify.text: Adjust the human decision while keeping the trail.

review.title: Review
review.text: Request a new examination while keeping the pending status.

cta.title: Discover a responsible approach to AI-assisted decision-making
cta.subtitle: Open the platform to create, analyse, explain and audit a decision file.
cta.startText: Open the application to create and audit your decision files.

footer.desc: Platform for tracing, explaining and auditing decisions assisted by artificial intelligence.
footer.stack: Built with Angular, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Scikit-learn, SHAP and Groq.
